canonical_form: sha256 over one line per carrier, `<path> <sha256 of the file with CRLF normalised to LF>`, the carriers in ascending path order, so the digest states the published content of the core and not the order the files were read in or the line endings a checkout produced
note: The digest of the administrative core's published carriers, next to the `dateModified` they were last dated at. `pnpm validate` and test/core-date-pinned.test.mjs recompute it and fail when the core has moved and this file has not, which is the releaser's prompt to date the release: set `dateModified`, run `node scripts/build-catalog.mjs`, then `pnpm pin-core-date --write`, which refuses while `dateModified` is older than the day it runs on. `data/poste/` is excluded: it is a mirror of @geoalgeria/poste and carries that package's date.
